method: WebFetch failed on every host tried (taxsummaries.pwc.com, www.oecd.org, en.wikipedia.org, www.gov.uk: 'getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND'), so NO page was read; every figure below is from a WebSearch result summary and is marked seenIn 'search-snippet'. Search results were restricted by domain where possible (taxsummaries.pwc.com for employer on-costs; ssa.gov / irs.gov / canada.ca for US and Canada). 'pct' is the plain SUM of the employer components the source listed (my addition, shown in 'components'); it is the rate below any ceiling — above a ceiling the effective % falls. Accident / work-injury insurance is excluded from 'pct' unless stated. Figures a summary gave only as 'about / roughly' are stored as null with the wording in 'note', per RULES.md.

employerOnCost.components: Pension 9.3% (half of 18.6%, ceiling EUR 101,400/yr) + unemployment 1.3% (half of 2.6%, ceiling EUR 101,400) + health 7.3% (half of 14.6%) + half of the average fund supplement 2.9% = 1.45% (health ceiling EUR 69,750/yr) + long-term care 1.8% (ceiling EUR 69,750; childless surcharge is employee-only) + insolvency levy 0.15% (ceiling EUR 101,400). Work-accident (BG) contribution is employer-only and sector-dependent — excluded.
